case_selection: all 16 cases whose node is N3 in test_plan_v1; no shortening or moving windows
tuning: only if a measured failure supports a causal change from the frozen v1 tuning grid; retain all prior results and freeze final parameters before final full execution/replay

stimulus.speed: original speed_ref Constant sets initial request; temporary root Sum/Step sources add declared changes, never replace the original block
stimulus.load: original T_load1 Before/After/Time, restored after the case
stimulus.noise: dedicated RandStream mt19937ar seed 20261016; 3 ABC values per 50us sample including t=0; injected only into observer sampled ABC before Clarke
stimulus.missing: observer sample-valid AND NOT(12000 <= control tick < 12005); no plant/controller sample removed
stimulus.reset: observer reset OR(control tick == 12000); no plant/controller state reset
stimulus.direction: declared direction from contract; no true rotor direction used
stimulus.detailed_bridge: gate_on=on for both 0us and 2us, comp_on/dead_on/drop_on=off, real timing on and ADC window off; native grid 62.5ns for full 0.8s

metrics.steady: all samples in [0.5,0.8], including invalid; v1 plant settled criteria and all precision/valid thresholds
metrics.cycles: absolute change of unwrapped true electrical angle / 2pi in declared window
metrics.speed_slope: least squares true rpm slope in declared steady window
metrics.dynamic: first full 20ms contiguous interval satisfying valid, absolute wrapped angle <=8deg, abs speed error <=3% of abs true speed; recovery measured at interval beginning, hold must finish before next event/end
metrics.event_time: record request and first current-task acceptance independently; no interpolation; acceptance at first logged observer sample at/after request
metrics.boundary: finite states, correct speed sign when target nonzero in steady window, full metrics and independently checked validity/reset/missing semantics; base precision not required
metrics.false_lock_diagnostic: report samples with valid=true but abs true angle error>8deg or relative speed error>3%; report counts, fraction and longest duration; truth only evaluation
metrics.state_semantics: independent v1 history/continuous-lock checker; missing 5 samples predict current and hold correction/filter/PLL integral; reset zeros observer states, valid false and full history/lock reacquisition
metrics.low_speed: report all 3 declared windows, EMF and false-valid limits; no relative accuracy pass claim at zero rpm

logging: unchanged full original timeseries, full control-rate observer logs and native voltage provenance; raw MAT v7.3 with hashes; no science decimation
execution: fresh MATLAB process and independent cache per case; model never saved; all original motor/PI/reference files preserved; source snapshots and phase log before execution
native_failure_policy: preserve each attempt; at most one retry per case only if launcher explicitly reports native 0xc0000005 or 0xc000001d, never retry a numerical failure as a pass; report interruption separately
replay: full final 16-case set in fresh processes; exact raw Time/Data equality, no interpolation; hashes verify integrity rather than MAT container-byte equality
gate: N2 accepted by user; stop for user acceptance at N3; no estimated feedback takeover
